data.summary: AEP mentionne explicitement l'IA et les data centers comme drivers majeurs de croissance de la demande d'électricité, avec impact significatif sur la stratégie d'investissement en transmission.
evidence: Risk Factors: 'Much of this demand is driven by interconnecting with and providing power to data centers and other large load customers to serve an increasingly digital economy and to support AI.'
MD&A: Investment in transmission assets driven by data center interconnection requirements
Capital plans focused on meeting AI-driven electricity demand
data.source: Rapport 10-K 2025, sections Business, Risk Factors et MD&A
